notes.title: [Update]Fixed a bug that caused the movie, Adding your name to credits(Holomem)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing holo8.

Updated holo8.

-Fixed a bug where the game movies would not play.

We have confirmed an issue where movies would not play in some environments, and have now fixed it.
We cannot guarantee that this fix has resolved the issue in all environments.
The reason is that the problem only occurs in a limited number of environments, and the development team was unable to confirm the problem. We asked the users who were experiencing the problem about their environments and details, and investigated the cause. Based on that, we are making the correction.
As a result, there may be environments in which the issue has not been fixed.
In that case, we apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate it if you could contact us by replying to the notification.

We will continue to work on this issue so that the issue is fixed in all environments.

notes.title: Update completed【Replacement of some "anomaly"】
notes.content:
Thank you for playing holo8.

Regarding holo8, we have updated the following points.

2025/2/21　xx:xx

As previously announced, we have completed the deletion of anomalies unrelated to Hololive memeber in “Anomaly Mode” and the addition of new anomalies to replace the deleted anomalies.

・Deleted anomaly: 21
・Added anomaly: 21

[b]The deleted anomalies are too minor anomalies that have nothing to do with Hololive member.
The anomaly added this time is related to Hololive member and Hololive member posters.[/b]
After this update, please focus on Hololive member and Hololive memeber posters and look for any anomalies.
(Hololive member may be hiding inside the office, so be sure not to miss them!)

There are two remaining anomalies that are not related to Hololive member, but these are not too minor anomalies, so they have not been removed in this update.

The newly added anomaly will appear in “Anomaly Mode”. Let’s find all the anomalies!

We will continue to make improvements so that you can enjoy the game, so we would appreciate it if you would continue to send us your opinions and impressions.

*Anomalies other than those deleted this time are not affected. Anomaly detection status other than deleted anomalies will not be reset.
*There are no changes to “Everyday Mode” this time.

[b]【About the “Anomaly List” notation after update】[/b]
Even if you have completed the anomaly list before the update, there will be more areas filled in black as shown in the image below.
This means that a new anomaly has been added in this update. The data of the discovered anomaly is not corrupted. This is a normal condition.
Due to a specification issue, there are more black parts. (If you add a new anomaly in the future, it will be added to the end of the anomaly list, but this time we deleted the anomaly, so the black part has increased to compensate for it.)
This will only occur in the special situation of deleting an anomaly. Please note that this will not occur when new anomalies are added in the future.

Thank you for your continued support.
